name: Club ballot
summary: A ranked-choice club election drawn as climbing walls: members tap the candidates in order and drop the slip in the box; on close the count plays as a climb, the last climber drops off and their ballots fly to next choices until someone tops out past half.
useWhen: club elections for president next week, 3 people running
can we do ranked choice for the board vote
who's running for treasurer, how do we vote
set up the officer election for the climbing club
dontUseWhen: a quick poll on where to eat (use a poll)
picking one plan by luck (use plan-spinner)
ranking lots of options for fun (use tier-list)

club.description: Club or group name, e.g. 'Eastfield Climbing Club'

members.description: Members in the whole group, e.g. 212

closes.description: When voting closes, as said, e.g. 'Fri 6pm'

outside.description: Ballots already in from members outside the chat

n.description: How many ballots ranked it this way

name.description: Their name as in the chat

rank.description: Their ranking by candidate name (kept secret)

said.description: What they said about it, in their words
